# aws-cur-analyzer

> Analyze AWS Cost and Usage Report CSV exports: amortized and unblended cost by service, account, region, tag or line item type, with exact Decimal sums Python package `trysac-aws-cur-analyzer`, import name `aws_cur_analyzer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
